crops.text: A P E XP R E D A T O R

(action) Choose any enemy creature to stand next to. If the chosen creature uses a non-forced ability, or if this creature takes any damage, this creature may immediately perform three attacks on the chosen creature. Upon performing these attacks, or at (BOT), stop standing next to the chosen creature.
When standing next to an enemy creature, this creature counts as
being in the same slot for the purposes of slot & lane targeting.
